rule: State of the Sending Analyzer's microphone input: two flags, listening and denied, both false at the start of every case unless 'from' says otherwise. 'startGranted' (permission is held and the capture opened) starts listening and clears denied. 'startDenied' (the system refused the microphone) sets denied. 'startFailed' (permission is held but the capture could not be opened: a dead input route, a 0 Hz format, an engine that would not start) leaves it not listening and clears denied. A start event while already listening changes nothing. 'interruptionBegan' (a call or another app took the audio), 'routeLost' (the input device went away or the capture died) and 'mediaServicesReset' stop listening; denied is untouched. 'interruptionEnded' changes nothing: the microphone does NOT resume by itself. Those four events while not listening change nothing. 'stop' (the screen left, the input was switched to the key) stops listening and leaves denied as it was.

cases.name: denied start sets the denied flag and does not listen
granting after a denial clears it
a failed capture is not a denial and clears an earlier one
interruption stops the microphone and the end of it does not resume
media services reset stops the microphone
stopping events while not listening change nothing, a denial included
a start while listening changes nothing
interruption ended while listening changes nothing
stop leaves the denied flag alone
listening again after a route loss
